[New]

📦 **Richer My Packages popup**: Tapping a parcel in the **My Packages** widget now shows much more PostNL data: **stage**, **weight in kg**, **dimensions (L × W × H)**, **PostNL Point**, **status since**, **registered** and **delivered** time, **delivery window type** and **observation code**.

🛣️ **Parcel journey in the popup**: The popup now includes the full **parcel journey** as a timeline, newest first, with date, time and location.

🔗 **Open in PostNL**: A new **Open in PostNL** button takes you straight to the parcel's Track & Trace page.

[Fix]

🖥️ **Status history on desktop**: Fixed the **Status history** capability showing an unreadable block of raw data that ran off the tile in the Homey web app. It now shows a clean, readable list.

🏷️ **Dutch capability name**: The *Observation code* capability now has a proper Dutch name (**Observatiecode**) instead of the untranslated English label.

[Improvement]

📋 **Readable status history**: The device now shows the **3 most recent PostNL events**, newest first, each with **date and time**, for example *09-10 06:47 – Pakket wordt gesorteerd*. The full history remains available as Flow token for advanced use.

🌟 Enjoy the improved PostNL v1.2.10 App with a richer My Packages popup and a cleaner device view on every screen.
